goal: Provide end-to-end backend evidence for deploy/secrets-sync/restart and resolve the gateway universe timeout cause with reproducible validation.

inputs.description: Gateway auth and universe route implementation.
Current blocked reasons and acceptance checklist.

constraints.notes: Deploy, permission elevation, and destructive commands require explicit User approval. Redact secret values in all evidence.

acceptance: Staging secrets-sync and service restart evidence is attached with timestamp and sanitized logs.
Fixed HTTPS endpoint probes are attached for /debug/token, /healthz, /gateway/session, and /gateway/universe_3d.
Timeout root cause for /gateway/universe_3d is either fixed or documented with mitigation and re-test evidence.

risk.note: Without deploy evidence and timeout resolution, CT must keep final status blocked.

next_actions: Submit result.json with exact commands, exit codes, and evidence paths.
Escalate immediately if approval-dependent deploy action is blocked.
Hand off timeout RCA and auth validation evidence to CT.
